title: Pre-Staging External HTTP Semantics Readiness Gate
statusRationale: The external HTTP semantics gate is defined and validator-backed, but staging-specific enablement remains blocked because 1e100.network currently serves the public JSON proof endpoint over plain HTTP instead of redirecting to HTTPS, while aldous.info already redirects correctly, and proof/control routes currently show Netlify Edge cache-hit or nonzero Age evidence despite declaring no-store cache policy.

blockers.observed: http://1e100.network/.well-known/usf-public-edge.json returns HTTP 200 through Cloudflare instead of a same-host HTTPS redirect. http://aldous.info/.well-known/usf-public-edge.json already returns a same-host HTTPS redirect.
blockers.requiredAction: Enable Always Use HTTPS or an equivalent same-host redirect rule for 1e100.network without changing ssh.aldous.info. Verify the HTTP proof route returns a 301 or 308 Location pointing to https://1e100.network/.well-known/usf-public-edge.json.

blockers.observed: HTTPS proof/control routes return Cache-Status "Netlify Edge" hit and nonzero Age while Cloudflare cache status is dynamic.
blockers.requiredAction: Deploy or configure the route implementation so proof/control routes emit ordinary and CDN no-store headers, purge or redeploy the provider cache, and verify the routes no longer report provider cache hit or nonzero Age.
